subject: BrightPath: price approval blockers — impact to Q2 forecast
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath — pricing approval delay impacting Q2 commit

Hannah,

Quick heads-up from RevOps: BrightPath (Deal RWI-2027-BP-1153) still has an outstanding concession request that hasn't landed with Deal Desk. Procurement wants a 20% list discount plus a bespoke data-retention clause; Legal flagged the clause as requiring extra review.

Current state: HubSpot shows this as "Commit - Pending" for Q2. If Deal Desk and Finance don't clear or provide an approved concession by EOD 24 Mar, we should move to "Commit - At Risk" to avoid overstating Q2 ARR. 

Why this matters:
- Forecast impact: ~$210k ARR on the line for Q2 if customer's timelines slip.
- Approval latency: longer reviews push signature into next quarter and inflate commit coverage.

Action requested:
1) Please confirm whether Sales will accept a cap (15%) or hold for 20% by EOD 24 Mar.
2) If you want Deal Desk to fast-track, include the updated proposal and any procurement asks (I've attached the latest pricing worksheet).

Attachment: BrightPath_pricing_worksheet_v3.xlsx (pricing summary + concession scenarios)

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath — pricing approval delay impacting Q2 commit

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the flag.

Quick update from Sales: I spoke with Sarah Patel this morning. BrightPath is keen to move forward but Procurement pushed back on standard retention language and asked for the 20% discount to compensate for additional compliance work. They said legal will need the clause reviewed, which is what's slowing us down.

I asked Sarah whether they'd accept a firm 15% cap instead of 20% to keep the contract within our standard risk profile; she said she'll check with Procurement but wants to see an updated proposal showing both options (15% w/ standard retention OR 20% pending Legal review).

Dylan, can you take point on pushing the updated proposal to Sarah and drop a Deal Desk intake note (include the pricing worksheet and the proposed clause text)? Karthik — can you confirm whether Finance can accept a revenue deferral for a partial concession if Deal Desk recommends it? If so, we may be able to preserve Commit while Legal completes review.

I will hold off on moving the HubSpot stage until we have either Deal Desk guidance or confirm rejection from the customer.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@brightpathhealth.com>, procurement@brightpathhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal and Deal Desk intake — BrightPath (RWI-2027-BP-1153)

Hi Sarah / BrightPath procurement team —

Thanks for taking time earlier. Per our conversation, attached is an updated proposal that includes two clearly labeled concession paths:

- Option A: 15% one-time concession, standard retention clause (fastest route to signature)
- Option B: 20% concession contingent on Legal review of the additional retention language (longer timeline)

We believe Option A preserves Q2 commit timing and keeps the deal within our standard risk box. If you prefer Option B, please confirm and we will route to Legal + Deal Desk for the conditional approval process.

Dylan (me) will coordinate any redline to the retention language. For Deal Desk / Finance: intake details and proposed numbers are in the attached redwood_proposal_BP-1153.pdf and the pricing worksheet previously shared. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/18327/DEAL-1153
DocuSign draft (pre-signed fields): https://www.docusign.com/links/BP-1153-proposal

Attachment: redwood_proposal_BP-1153.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Deal Desk decision: BrightPath — 15% concession approved to preserve Q2 Commit

Hannah / Team —

Final update from Deal Desk & Finance: Deal Desk reviewed the intake and Legal's note. To keep the deal aligned with our Q2 targets while limiting revenue risk, Deal Desk approved Option A (15% concession) with the following controls:

- Finance-approved revenue deferral for the concession portion across the first two billing cycles (documented in deal impact summary).
- Legal to run the proposed retention language through an expedited review track; no signed agreement containing non-standard retention will be accepted without separate Legal sign-off.
- Sales to confirm customer acceptance of Option A by replying to the DocuSign link before EOD 25 Mar.

I updated HubSpot to mark the deal as "Commit" (restored) with a note on the concession and the approved deferral treatment. See impact summary attached.

Attachment: deal_impact_summary_BP-1153.csv
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/18327/DEAL-1153

If Sales confirms signature, Finance will include the adjusted ARR in the Q2 commit but the deferral will be reflected in the monthly close.

Thanks all — and shout if you need a copy of the approval thread for audit.

Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
